visualize_matrix_on_image: create a MatrixVisualizer to overlay a color-mapped matrix onto an image region defined by a bounding box
draw_rectangle_on_image: create a RectangleVisualizer to draw a colored rectangle on an image at a given bounding box
draw_points_on_image: create a PointsVisualizer to draw colored circles at specified coordinate points on an image
render_text_on_image: create a TextVisualizer to render styled text with optional fill and frame on an image
chain_visualizers_together: create a CompoundVisualizer to apply multiple visualizers in sequence on a single image
